name: AWS Change Review Guard
description: Plan-before-apply discipline for Terraform, CloudFormation and CDK: applies without a reviewed plan or change set, targeted/replace applies, lock and refresh bypasses, IAM-capability stacks, rollback and stack-policy overrides, and CDK hotswap need a written reason; removing termination protection needs admin approval; plan and change-set generation is logged as review evidence. Complements Terraform Baseline (which gates apply/destroy outright).

rules.name: Require access request to remove CloudFormation termination protection
rules.description: Disabling termination protection is the step before deleting a protected stack. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: Require justification to apply Terraform without a reviewed plan file
rules.description: terraform apply with no saved plan re-plans and applies in one step, so what runs was never reviewed. Requires a written reason. Instead: terraform plan -out=tfplan, review it, then terraform apply tfplan.

rules.name: Require justification for targeted or replace applies
rules.description: -target and -replace skip the full plan, so dependent resources are changed without being reviewed. Requires a written reason. Instead: apply the full plan, or split the change into its own module.

rules.name: Require justification to bypass state locking or refresh
rules.description: -lock=false risks concurrent writes to the same state; -refresh=false plans against stale state. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: Require justification to select a prod Terraform workspace
rules.description: Switching to a workspace named prod points every following plan/apply at production. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: Require justification to create or update CloudFormation stacks without a change set
rules.description: create-stack / update-stack apply immediately; nobody sees the diff. Requires a written reason. Instead: create-change-set, review with describe-change-set, then execute-change-set.

rules.name: Require justification for cloudformation deploy that executes its change set immediately
rules.description: aws cloudformation deploy creates and executes the change set in one step unless --no-execute-changeset is passed. Requires a written reason. Instead: deploy --no-execute-changeset, review, then execute-change-set.

rules.name: Require justification to execute a CloudFormation change set
rules.description: execute-change-set is the moment the reviewed change is applied. Requires a written reason that names who reviewed the change set.

rules.name: Require justification for stacks that create or expand IAM resources
rules.description: CAPABILITY_IAM / CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM / CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND acknowledge that the template creates IAM principals or runs macros. Requires a written reason so the IAM changes are reviewed with the plan.

rules.name: Require justification to disable rollback or override the stack policy
rules.description: --disable-rollback / --on-failure DO_NOTHING leave a failed stack half-applied; --stack-policy-during-update-body and set-stack-policy lift the protections on critical resources. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: Require justification for CDK hotswap or deploy-all
rules.description: cdk deploy --hotswap bypasses CloudFormation (no change set, no rollback); --all or '*' deploys every stack in the app at once. Requires a written reason. Instead: cdk diff <stack>, then cdk deploy <stack>.

rules.name: Warn on cancelled or resumed stack updates
rules.description: cancel-update-stack and continue-update-rollback are recovery steps that leave resources in a mixed state. Records a warning.

rules.name: Log plan and change-set generation as review evidence
rules.description: terraform plan, cdk diff, create-change-set and describe-change-set are the review step. Logging them gives the plan-before-apply control its evidence that a plan existed before the apply. Does not block or warn.
